inputs.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 90.13 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.22 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. Hanuš2021 ASAS-SN study lists349 measurements and two poles. Select6039 as the first archived convex solution; the mirror6040 remains scientifically allowed. ASAS-SN photometry constrains broad shape and spin, not resolved terrain. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
